created.description: The set of UI metadata that was created.

updated.description: The set of UI metadata that was updated.

removed.description: The set of UI metadata that was removed.

title:
An audit trail of changes to UI metadata as part of an app development operation,
e.g. creating new pages, deleting pages, creating components, etc.

An instance of this type should be treated as an atomic change, i.e. no single portion
of this change set makes sense without the rest. Any undo/redo features should
be sure to rollback/apply *all* changes in this change set at the same time.
name: UiSdlMetadataChangeSet
